reason: I lost a sale last month because I was slow sending the file, and with Maketia I still have to confirm each payment and send the link myself. My current platform already gives me a sales page, so switching for the same manual work makes no sense.
objection: If I still have to confirm each payment by hand and send the download link myself, what do I gain over what I use today? Automatic confirmation is only 'planned'.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation with the download link sent to the buyer instantly, without me touching my phone.
